+"""Camera-guided controller for one Meta-World sweep-v3 episode.
+
+Run with --target X Y Z --grip G to move the mocap hand target to a waypoint.
+The service keeps the episode state across invocations; each call logs its result.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path

+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image

+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+
+
+def save_observation(result, label):
+    for camera, frame in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"{label}_{camera}.png")
+    for camera, depth in result.depth.items():
+        np.save(OUT / f"{label}_{camera}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (OUT / f"{label}.json").write_text(json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+def move_to(robot, target, grip, label, settle=0):
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    cameras = list(spec["cameras"])
+    before = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True)
+    names = before.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    state = dict(zip(names, before.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    start = np.array([state["mocap_x"], state["mocap_y"], state["mocap_z"]])
+    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
+    delta = target - start
+    count = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / 0.01)))
+    action = np.r_[delta / (0.01 * count), grip]
+    actions = np.repeat(action[None, :], count, axis=0)
+    if settle:
+        actions = np.vstack((actions, np.tile([0, 0, 0, grip], (settle, 1))))
+    result = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=spec["control_dt"], cameras=cameras,
+                          include_depth=True, video="frames", note=label)
+    save_observation(result, label)
+    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "start_mocap": start.tolist(), "target_mocap": target.tolist(),
+                      "action": action.tolist(), "steps": len(actions), "meta": result.meta}, default=str))
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("--target", nargs=3, type=float, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--grip", type=float, default=1.0)
+    p.add_argument("--label", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--settle", type=int, default=0)
+    args = p.parse_args()
+    move_to(Robot(), args.target, args.grip, args.label, args.settle)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
